instruction: Find all men's extra-large short-sleeve shirts with a discount of 70% or more.

metadata.explanation: Task variation: Men's short-sleeve shirts with extra-large size and 70% discount filter. Uses existing url_path_parse getter and check_direct_json_object metric. Expected values match Macy's URL parameter format for men's clothing, shirts category, size XL, 70% discount range, and short sleeve style.

llm_judge_reasons: Complete coverage: Evaluator checks ALL requirements from the instruction (men's clothing, shirts, extra-large size, short-sleeve, 70% discount)
Correct getter logic: get_macys_product_url_parse correctly extracts and parses Macy's URL filtering parameters including category, size, sleeve style, and discount range
Correct metric logic: check_direct_json_object properly compares all expected key-value pairs and returns 1.0 only when ALL values match
Semantically correct expected values: XL = extra-large, 70_PERCENT_ off & more = 70% or more discount, short_sleeve = short-sleeve shirts - all match instruction requirements
Practical feasibility: Getter can extract state from active Chrome tab URL, metric can correctly compare parsed parameters
No semantic or logical issues detected: Data flow is correct from URL parsing to comparison
